governance.note: The 2026-07-10-nyiso-60-ldc-transport keeper recipe VERBATIM with exactly ONE change, and it is a MEASURED-DATA transmission-limit swap, not a tuned parameter (rules 12/13/14/17, zero new free parameters): nyiso_nyc_lcr_tsl=True. In the summer-peak design-condition window (HB14-21, NYISO_SELFSUPPLY_FLOOR_HOURS - the condition the LCR locality requirements are defined at) the Lower_Hudson->NYC (Dunwoodie-South) link's import limit is capped at the PUBLISHED NYISO NYC-locality Bulk-Power Transmission Capability import limit (data/raw/capacity-deliverability/nyiso/nyiso.csv 'NYC' import_limit = 2,875 MW every capability year 2023/24-2025/26), REPLACING the link's 3,900 MW Gold-Book energy-TTC estimate; every other hour keeps the physical rating. This is the Zone-J analog of the already-active Zone-K nyiso_li_lcr_tsl cap (issue #1345), applied identically. RULE-14 boundary (clean, parallel to the LI cap): the 2,875 MW is the AC transmission-security import limit; the controllable HVDC ties into Zone J (Neptune/HTP/Linden-VFT) are the SEPARATE priced import-node link (IMPORT_NODE_LINKS['NYISO'] ('NYC', 1000.0)) and stay at their physical rating, so the cap limits only the Dunwoodie-South AC link, not total NYC import. Measured and forward-native (the NYISO Locality Bulk-Power Transmission Capability tables publish every capability year and respond to new cables/topology; regenerates for a forward year and responds to changed conditions). It is a transmission limit, NOT a min_gen floor - it forces no energy (the D-2 budget is unchanged; NYC reliability energy clears in merit order), so it is not on the zero-forcing ablation off-list and stays ON in the twin. All other mechanisms (nyiso_downstate_ct_gas_daily per-zone daily LDC-transport delivered gas, measured hourly reserve requirements #1344 B2+B3 dynamic RR, measured zonal load shares, Zone-K LCR/TSL, measured neighbor hub import pricing, CAMPD outage overlay, F923 fuel costs, plant emission rates v2) carried UNCHANGED from the nyiso-60 keeper.
governance.residuals_note: A/B RESULT (vs the nyiso-60 keeper at the same HEAD, v2.4 load-weighted price basis): a near-null price effect - the measured NYC AC-import limit (2,875 MW) vs the 3,900 MW estimate does NOT move the level materially and does NOT close the deep (>$300) tail. C3a 2023 -3.7% PASS (keeper -4.8%), 2024 -12.8% (keeper -13.2%), 2025 -13.7% (keeper -13.7%) - marginally better or equal every year. C3b 2023 0.156 PASS (keeper 0.163), 2024 0.222 (keeper 0.223), 2025 0.198 PASS (keeper 0.199) - marginally better every year. C3c >$300 model tail: 2023 28h vs DA 1h/RT 10h (keeper 23h - slightly MORE over-count on the already-ledgered G-20a DA-basis artifact), 2024 3h PASS (DA 0/RT 12), 2025 25h vs DA 12h = 2.08x/RT 42h (keeper 25h - UNCHANGED; the 2025 deep tail did NOT close). C1 fuel-mix 14/14 PASS all years (free 10/10), C2 PASS, C4 PASS, C7 PASS, C8 clean PASS (ST_GAS grounded-above-budget, D-4 off-window 0.0%) - all IDENTICAL to the keeper. C5a CO2 +3.3/+2.5/+8.1% - IDENTICAL to the keeper (2025 commercial-band auto-caveat). FINDING: the NYC AC-import capability distinction (3,900 vs 2,875 MW) is NOT the binding scarcity lever for the NYISO deep price tail in these years; the residual sits at the B1 condition-varying reserve-requirement increments and the Iroquois Z2 winter hub (both data-blocked, below). Per rule 1 the measured limit is KEPT and PROMOTED on its structural-faithfulness basis (published NYISO transmission-security limit > Gold-Book estimate - the exact promotion logic of nyiso-56 measured load shares, nyiso-59 measured hourly requirements, nyiso-60 measured delivered gas), NOT on residual movement, and never chased with a tuned adder (rules 11/26). Zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside (2026-07-11-nyiso-61-downstate-import-ablation).

_open_items: (1) 2024 (mild year) + 2025 DEEP (>$300) price tail still UNDER the RT actual - nyiso-61 CONFIRMED that downstate import discipline is NOT the binding lever: applying the MEASURED NYC locality import limit (2,875 MW, capacity-deliverability) in place of the 3,900 MW Dunwoodie-South estimate is a near-null price change and leaves the 2025 deep tail unchanged (25h vs 42h RT). The remaining open levers are (2) and (3). (2) #1344 B1 residual: condition-varying largest-contingency / forecast-uncertainty reserve-requirement increments - formal NYISO Market Operations request ONLY; the derived requirement series is a documented lower bound in non-TSA hours; the 2024 deep-tail undershoot (1 vs 12 RT h) sits here. (3) Iroquois Z2 winter hub (Ask-C, licensed-data ask) - the Dec-2024/Dec-2025 winter level has no measured monthly anchor. (4) C3c is scored on the DA-expressible basis (G-20a) - the RT-like tail the co-opt produces (28/3/25 h) is not credited until settlement-price scoring lands; 2025 trips the DA gate at 2.08x while sitting 17h UNDER the RT actual. (5) nyiso_nyc_lcr_tsl adds NO free parameter (a measured published limit behind a boolean gate, parallel to nyiso_li_lcr_tsl); the near-null effect is the finding, not a tuning target. CI replay of this recipe OOMs GitHub-hosted runners in regenerate_clean - solve locally with >= 15 GB + swap.
